The main takeaway from our work is that
for the Euclidean multi-connectivity problems the time-bound of the known PTASs is not necessarily the best possible.
PTASs can be designed for multi-connectivity problems by exploiting the structure of their single-connectivity counterparts.
, for the Euclidean multi-connectivity problems we consider, the complexity of the single-connectivity problems is a very poor predictor for the complexity of the multi-connectivity problems.
